listen_address.description: Address and port on which Node Exporter will listen for incoming Prometheus scrapes (e.g., ':9100' or '0.0.0.0:9100').

worker_limit.description: Maximum number of concurrent scrape workers. Increase for high-load environments.

metrics_path.description: Path under which metrics are exposed. Standard is '/metrics'; change only if needed (e.g., due to reverse proxy routing).

collectors.description: List of collectors to enable or disable. Each item defines the collector name and whether it's enabled.

enabled.description: Whether to enable (true) or explicitly disable (false) the collector.

collector_options.description: List of additional command-line arguments for collector-specific tuning (e.g., '--filesystem.ignored-mount-points=^/(sys|proc|dev|etc|var/lib/docker)($|/)' ).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting.

log_format.description: Format of log output. 'logfmt' is human-friendly; 'json' is better for structured logging.

pid_file.description: Optional path to write PID file (e.g., '/run/node_exporter.pid'). Required for systemd `Type=notify` and safe restarts.

web_timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Reduce if scrape timeouts are frequent.

web_max_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP requests. 0 means unlimited. Set to limit memory/CPU usage.

web_enable_lifecycle.description: Enable POST endpoints for reload, shutdown, etc. Use only in trusted environments.

web_enable_admin_api.description: Enable admin API endpoints (e.g., DELETE series). Rarely needed for Node Exporter; keep disabled by default.
